q1_issues.issue: "new" is folded into the run-rule's consequent as `(Member $x new)`, making being-new a consequence of group membership bundled with the running claim, when a descriptive modifier on a definite plural takes its own distribution rule and belongs to the referring NP rather than to what was said.
"the x86 version of Solaris" is encoded `(PartOf sk_version_1 solaris)`, but a version is not a component of Solaris, so the genitive test selects the opaque `Possession` instead.

The definite plural "the new servers" with a distributive predicate yields only the per-member rule; the group-level run event that the plural rules predicate over as a unit is not emitted alongside it.

q2_gaps: Sealing a QUANTIFIED complement — a multi-atom attitude complement is specified to seal as `(And …)`, but nothing states how an `(Implication …)` rule (what a definite-plural distributive complement produces) is sealed under `Theme`.
A post-posed quotative ", he said" with no "that" complementizer — the propositional-attitude section is written for a finite clausal "that"-complement.
notes: The antecedent-less "he" correctly becomes `sk_person_1`/`person`, the `Or` is scoped narrowly around only the varying `Theme`, `Future` sits inside the rule consequent, and the definite referents inside the seal have their typing projected at top level.
